options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_html:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_fr:
Un système qui peut déplacer la progression plus tôt, pour essayer et empêcher le joueur de se coincer et s'ennuyer tôt.

Un réglage plus bas signifie qu'il reste coincé. Un réglage plus élevé signifie moins se coincer.
options.doc_html_fr:
Un système qui peut déplacer la progression plus tôt, pour essayer et empêcher le joueur de se coincer et s'ennuyer tôt.

Un réglage plus bas signifie qu'il reste coincé. Un réglage plus élevé signifie moins se coincer.

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.
options.doc_html:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

Full: ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

Minimal: ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.
options.doc_fr:
Définir les règles d'accessibilité de vos objets/emplacements.

**Full:** s'assurer que tout peut être atteint et acquis.

**Minimal:** s'assurer que ce qui est nécessaire pour atteindre votre objectif peut être acquis.
options.doc_html_fr:
Définir les règles d'accessibilité de vos objets/emplacements.

Full: s'assurer que tout peut être atteint et acquis.

Minimal: s'assurer que ce qui est nécessaire pour atteindre votre objectif peut être acquis.

options.name: Level Clears Gives Planets?
options.doc: Determines if clearing levels gives the player Planets (up to 48 planets)
options.doc_fr: Détermine si les niveaux de clairance donnent au joueur Planètes (jusqu'à 48 planètes)

options.name: Planets in Item Pool
options.doc: The total amount of planets to be added to the item pool.

options.name: Planets Requirement Type
options.doc: Whether the goal is defined as a percentage of planets in the pool, or a specific amount of planets.

options.name: Planet Requirement Percentage
options.doc:
The percentage of total planets needed to unlock the final level "That Hole..." and beat the game.
Only used if 'Planet Requirement Type' is 'percentage'

options.name: Planets Requirement Count
options.doc:
The amount of total planets needed to unlock the final level "That Hole..." and beat the game.
Only used if 'Planet Requirement Type' is 'count'

options.name: Death Link
options.doc: When you die, everyone who enabled death link dies. Of course, the reverse is true too.
options.doc_html: When you die, everyone who enabled death link dies. Of course, the reverse is true too.
options.doc_fr: Quand vous mourez, tous ceux qui ont permis la mort meurent. Bien sûr, l'inverse est vrai aussi.
options.doc_html_fr: Quand vous mourez, tous ceux qui ont permis la mort meurent. Bien sûr, l'inverse est vrai aussi.

options.name: Randomize Cousins
options.doc: Determines whether rolling up cousins will grant checks (up to 69 locations).
options.doc_fr: Déterminer si les cousins en alternance accorderont des vérifications (jusqu'à 69 emplacements).

options.name: Randomize Presents
options.doc: Determines whether rolling up presents will grant checks (up to 39 locations).
options.doc_fr: Détermine si le roulement des cadeaux accordera des vérifications (jusqu'à 39 emplacements).

options.name: Randomize Crowns
options.doc: Determines whether rolling up crowns will grant checks (up to 141 locations).
options.doc_fr: Déterminer si les couronnes montantes accorderont des vérifications (jusqu'à 141 emplacements).

options.name: Skip Tutorial
options.doc: Skips the tutorial.
options.doc_fr: Ça passe le tutoriel.

options.name: Starting Level Count
options.doc: The number of levels that you will start with.

options.name: Exclude Levels
options.doc: Prevents these levels from showing up in the seed.
options.doc_fr: Empêche ces niveaux d'apparaître dans les graines.

options.name: Collectionsanity
options.doc:
Adds checks for rolling up objects in the collection.

Individual: Grants a check for every individual unique object in the collection. E.g. Collectionsanity: Tomato
Milestones: Grants a check for every x amount of unique objects rolled up. E.g. Collectionsanity: 100 objects
options.doc_fr:
Ajoute des contrôles pour rouler les objets dans la collection.

Individual: Donne un chèque pour chaque objet unique de la collection. Par exemple Collectionsanity: Tomato Milestones: Donne une vérification pour chaque x quantité d'objets uniques roulés. Par exemple Collectionnalité : 100 objets

options.name: Milestones
options.doc:
How many unique objects must be rolled up before granting a check.
Only used when Collectionsanity is 'milestones'.
options.doc_fr:
Combien d'objets uniques doivent être enroulés avant d'accorder un contrôle.
Utilisé uniquement lorsque Collectionsanity est 'millestones'.

options.name: Out of Logic
options.doc:
How many unique objects that are possible to roll up are considered out of logic.
e.g. If you can roll up 100 unique objects, but set this value to 20, 80 will be considered in logic.
Only used when Collectionsanity is 'milestones'.
options.doc_fr:
Combien d'objets uniques qui sont possibles à rouler sont considérés par logique.
Par exemple, si vous pouvez rouler 100 objets uniques, mais définissez cette valeur à 20, 80 seront considérés en logique.
Utilisé uniquement lorsque Collectionsanity est 'millestones'.

options.name: Local Fill Percentage
options.doc:
The percentage of collectionsanity checks that will be forced to have a local junk item.
Recommended to keep high when using individual mode or a very low milestone such as 1.
Recommended to turn down when using higher milestones.

options.name: Rocket Weight
options.doc: The weight of Rockets in the freebie pool.

options.name: Magnet Weight
options.doc: The weight of Magnets in the freebie pool.

options.name: Sonar Weight
options.doc: The weight of Sonars in the freebie pool.

options.name: Timer Weight
options.doc: The weight of Timers in the freebie pool.

options.name: Mushroom Weight
options.doc:
The weight of Mushrooms in the freebie pool.
This freebie increases your Katamari's size by 10%.

options.name: Ice Axe Weight
options.doc:
The weight of Ice Axes (Also known as "Pickels") in the freebie pool.
This freebie allows you to scale walls higher and faster.

options.name: Super Freebie Chance
options.doc:
The chance a freebie will be replaced by its super variant.
Super Mushroom increases your Katamari's size by 20%.
All other super freebies last twice as long as their regular variant.

options.name: Junk/Trap Chance
options.doc: The chance an unfilled location will be filled with a junk or trap item.

options.name: Stardust Weight
options.doc: The weight of Stardust (junk item) in the junk/trap pool.

options.name: Washpan Trap Weight
options.doc:
The weight of Washpan Traps in the junk/trap pool.
This trap decreases your Katamari's size by 10%.

options.name: Spider Trap Weight
options.doc:
The weight of Spider Traps in the junk/trap pool.
This trap causes you to move slower.

options.name: Fog Trap Weight
options.doc:
The weight of Fog Traps in the junk/trap pool.
This trap adds the fog from 'Lots of Yokai', and will slowly dissipate over time.
Does not activate while in 'Lots of Yokai'.
